# ToonSquid

> > ToonSquid is a professional animation studio app for iPad that combines traditional frame-by-frame animation with modern vector graphics, rigging, and inverse kinematics.

ToonSquid brings professional 2D animation capabilities to iPad and Apple Pencil users, supporting both traditional hand-drawn animation workflows and advanced digital techniques like keyframe animation and character rigging. The app is designed specifically for iPad Pro and optimized for touch and pencil input.

## Key Topics

- iPad animation app
- Traditional animation
- Frame-by-frame animation
- Keyframe animation
- Vector graphics
- Timeline and layers
- Character rigging
- Inverse kinematics (IK)
- Apple Pencil support
- Vector brushes
- 2D animation studio
- Digital art tools
- Animation keyframing
- iPad Pro optimization
